notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nonlegendary artifact.
You are the monarch.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Stasis and Court of Vantress' second ability triggers.
Resolve the Court of Vantress trigger, creating a token of any nonlegendary artifact you control.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the artifact token, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Repeat during each of your turns.
As long as Stasis is on the battlefield, players skip their untap steps.
